# Clean fixture

A cron job looks for deliveries that never reported back and queues them
again, every five minutes, for up to three days.

The report covers 2020–2024. The identifier `grants_that_are_really_there`
is code.

```sh
echo "a — b"
```

The export can take a minute. The Dialer API and the dialer API answer
on dialer-api.local, see hausgold/dialer-api#279 and `dialer-api`.

Der Job prüft alle fünf Minuten, ob eine Lieferung hängt, und stellt sie
erneut ein.
